summary: SB Tracking P3 Lot 1 (Employees PDF + invitations + Fleet PDF) — Backend 16/16 pass; Frontend 4/4 critical flows pass. PDF endpoints return 200 + application/pdf, invite endpoint returns 200 with email, invalid email/missing name return 400, ?code= prefill works.
critical_code_review_comments: Toast 'PDF téléchargé' may auto-dismiss before user notices on slow networks (sonner default ~4s); not a bug — endpoint returns 200 + application/pdf as expected.
EmployeesPage.js add-employee-btn is only rendered when employees.length > 0 (else add-first-employee is used); both were verified.
seed_data_creation: Demo employees were already present from previous iteration; no extra seed needed. Created TEST_PWInvitee + TEST_LocalOnly and cleaned them up via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P3 Lot 1 flows verified end-to-end on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: (1) /api/employees/report.pdf -> 200 application/pdf captured via network listener; (2) /api/fleet/report.pdf -> 200 application/pdf; (3) POST /api/employees/invite -> 200 with valid email, error toast 'Email valide requis' shown for invalid; (4) EmployeeJoinPage?code=EMPABC12 pre-fills join-code-input correctly (uppercased). 'Ajouter' (save-employee-btn) creates a local slot without email and shows 'Employé ajouté' toast. Backend pytest covers same paths (test_employees_report_pdf, test_fleet_report_pdf, test_invite_employee_sends_and_creates_slot, test_invite_requires_valid_email).
